question.prompt: Name a science-fiction TV series set in space or about space travel.
question.criteria: Any released live-action or animated science-fiction TV series in which outer space or travel between worlds is a central part of the setting or premise.

answers.evidence: Star Trek follows the crew of the starship Enterprise as they explore space.
Doctor Who follows a time traveler whose TARDIS travels through both time and space.
The Mandalorian follows a bounty hunter traveling between worlds in the Star Wars galaxy.
The Expanse depicts human societies and conflicts across a colonized Solar System.
Firefly follows the crew of the spaceship Serenity as they take jobs across a frontier star system.
Battlestar Galactica follows a fleet of human survivors traveling through space after an attack by the Cylons.
Lost in Space follows the Robinson family's adventures after their space mission goes off course.
Star Trek: The Next Generation follows Captain Picard and the crew of the Enterprise.
Star Trek: Voyager follows a starship crew stranded far from home in the Delta Quadrant.
Star Trek: Deep Space Nine centers on a space station near a stable wormhole.
Star Wars: The Clone Wars is an animated series about a war fought across the Star Wars galaxy.
Cowboy Bebop follows spacefaring bounty hunters traveling around the Solar System.
Red Dwarf is a science-fiction comedy about the inhabitants of a spaceship far from Earth.
Babylon 5 centers on a space station that serves as a meeting place for multiple civilizations.
The Orville follows the crew of an exploratory spacecraft.
Farscape follows an astronaut who joins alien fugitives aboard a living spaceship.
Stargate Universe follows people stranded aboard the ancient spaceship Destiny.
Star Wars Rebels follows a spaceship crew resisting the Galactic Empire.
Andromeda follows a starship captain and crew attempting to restore an interstellar commonwealth.
The 2015 series Dark Matter follows a spaceship crew who awaken without their memories.
Space: 1999 follows the inhabitants of a lunar base after the Moon is hurled out of Earth's orbit.
Blake's 7 follows spacefaring rebels fighting an authoritarian interstellar Federation.
Lexx follows a group of misfits traveling aboard a powerful living spacecraft.
Space: Above and Beyond follows space-based military aviators during a war with aliens.
Outlaw Star is an anime about a crew traveling through space aboard an advanced starship.
Futurama follows an interplanetary delivery crew in the future.
Star Trek: Enterprise follows an early human deep-space exploration mission.
Killjoys follows bounty hunters working across a planetary system known as the Quad.
Other Space is a comedy series about a spaceship crew stranded in an unfamiliar universe.
Stargate SG-1 follows a team exploring other planets through an alien portal network.
Stargate Atlantis follows an expedition based in an ancient alien city in another galaxy.

question.explanation: Space-travel television spans starship adventures, interplanetary dramas, animated comedies and more. Individual series within franchises count as separate answers.
